channel.title: Alice’sDiary
channel.description:
Hello my internet friends!
I'm Alice, a 23yr old girl & a master's student at Uni of Oxford;) Raised in CN but educated in the UK, I have a lot to share regarding my thoughts on both my life and the world!
So, I decided to do a mixed language podcast, using both Eng and Chinese to express my ideas~ I want to create a safe & intimate place where I could share everything from personal experiences, academic and career stress to health, relationship and learning tips.
Enjoy!
channel.itunes:author: Aliceeew

item.title: EP12【全英】Snow in Ox, first formal, solo date in Manchester✨
item.description:
Cannot believe Oxford snowed??? It's only November and we had this quite heavy snow, which is just freezing🥶

Also had my first formal dinner in New college! A really beautiful college yet the food was average...

Finally, I went on a solo date to Manchester! Such a full but happy week, hope you are doing great as well:D

Enjoy!

item.title: EP11 【全英】My thoughts on ZJU scholarship ranking
item.description:
Hey guys!

Finally remember to record this week!

So this week's episode is a little weekly catchup, but also a short discussion on the ZJU student scholarship ranking incident (it's just sad seeing universities still doing the useless ranking stuff and trying to find out who is more superior...

But anyways, hope you enjoy this one and see you next week!

Alice x

item.title: EP10【全英】busy period at Oxford & my daily routine:)
item.description:
Another chatty episode regarding what my life looks like right now and my utmost open and honest daily routine for surviving it hahaha

Enjoy listening!

Alice xx

item.title: EP09【全英】My first Oxford lecture (with afterclass thoughts)
item.description:
Thank you for 130 followers!!!! Cannot believe it😭

And sorry for being inactive again... The first two weeks are like hell (but learning new things is still rewarding haha)

In this episode, I quickly went through my first two weeks in Oxford, how my day looked like, and talked briefly about the thoughts I have towards Chinese Higher Education System (yeah I know, sounds boring but is actually thought-provoking!)

Enjoy and have a nice weekend xx

Alice❤️

item.title: EP08【全英】Induction week in Oxford! A hectic week...
item.description:
This week is so busy and hectic! OMG

Everyday is full of events, activities and stuff to do! I went to the college induction event, the departmental events and the freshers' fair... 

Met loads of people, made some friends, still work in progress:)

Enjoy listening! Alice x

item.title: EP07.1【中】来牛津两周后的小小感想｜播客更新形式update
item.description:
久违的中文播客来了！（虽然有点短我知道😭

简单跟大家更新下我的近况，但可能后面会以英文单集为主了...不知道大家有没有想听的主题呀，我有点灵感枯竭，想听听大家的意见哈哈哈！

爱大家：）假期快乐！

item.title: EP07【全英】2nd week in Oxford & haven't made any friends...
item.description:
Hello beautiful people!

It's my second week in Oxford, and we still haven't started our class yet... So instead I pushed myself to go out and visit some libraries, really impressive!

But I'm also aware that I don't have any friends here... which is the main topic of this episode: how to socialise and make friends, is it okay not to make any friends? 

If you are struggling with it or just want to see my situation right now, then check this episode out!

item.title: EP06【全英】Everything I did during my first week in Oxford!
item.description:
I've made it to Oxford!

Yet the first week is always challenging... I travelled back and forth to London twice, unpacked and organised my stuff, and sorted out every necessary procedures🤯

But I was also fortunate enough to receive help from friends, families and teachers❤️ So wanna say thank you to everyone who helped and supported me:)

Last but not least, thank you for listening! Can't wait to bring you all along with my new and exciting journey :D

item.title: EP05【全英】weekly catchup & farewell China!
item.description:
Thanks so so much for 50 subscribers!!! I'll definitely keep on posting in the coming days:)

By the time you guys listen to this episode, I will be in 🇬🇧 busy unpacking & organising haha, so this episode is also a casual chitchat about my last week in China: what I did to celebrate the mid-autumn festival, the process of creating a vision board, and my feelings of farewell.

Enjoy!

item.title: EP04【全英】Plans for the next academic year
item.description:
Hey everyone! Happy mid-autumn festival!

Hope you are having a wonderful holiday so far:)

I wasn't feeling good last week, so I went to do a blood test, which showed some alarming signs.... based on that, I have set a well-rounded plan for my next academic year, fingers crossed I could stick to them and build a healthier body🙏

Stay healthy and enjoy your life! Love you all :3

item.title: EP03【中】我是‘师生粉’？聊聊我与老师的关系
item.description:
祝所有老师教师节快乐！

上周我终于得偿所愿，回初中看了最喜欢的几位老师们❤️

趁着教师节，想跟大家分享我与老师们的关系，以及我和老师相处的小思考。

祝大家听得愉快～

item.title: EP02【全英】Recap my 22 (cant believe I'm 23 soon)
item.description:
Helloooo guys! Happy weekend! Hope you are enjoying your weekend so far:)

As I'm about to turn 23 (next WED omg), I decided to do a recap on my 22. I talked about my changing mindset when dealing with age growth, things I achieved in the past year, as well as some reminders to my future self. 

If you are also in your 20s and you are struggling with growing up, then hope we can support each other together:D
